True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    colors = list(counts)
    if len(colors) == 1:
        return [[colors[0] for _ in row] for row in grid]
    background = max(colors, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    other = next(c for c in colors if c != background)
    return [[other if value == background else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
